_README: Channel presets — a STARTING POINT for an installer, never an assertion. Numbers here are metro LCNs and go stale: regional affiliates renumber, networks close and launch channels. Every preset is marked unverified; an installer prunes and confirms on site, and only then is it exposed. Correct a number once here and every future install starts right. 'slug' points at the artwork in appart/ — shared with apps, so nothing needs a separate channel tile pack.

au_free_to_air.name: Australian free-to-air (metro)
au_free_to_air.note: Metro numbering. Regional affiliates differ — confirm on the customer's own tuner before committing.

foxtel_au.name: Foxtel (Australia)
foxtel_au.note: Numbers NOT pre-filled: a Foxtel line-up depends on the customer's package, and a wrong number tunes the wrong thing. Add the channels this customer actually receives, reading the numbers off their box.
